profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. describes itself as a company that owns, operates, and scales purpose-built businesses acquiring, deploying, and monetizing specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. It says this portfolio provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies like AI and Bitcoin mining.

The company's website reports that Hut 8 has fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 Billion.

Hut 8 Corp. is a public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, trading under ticker HUT, with SEC CIK 0001964789. The company has 96 legal exposure entries in Florida.
